objective: Keep BATCH-001 on two decision-critical novelty screens: a fully charged attack mechanism and a verifiable cryptanalytic methodology.

candidates.title: Fully charged ECDLP mechanism frontier
candidates.uncertainty: Whether any operation-level novel generic-model escape, structured-curve lever, relation/descent mechanism, or multi-target tradeoff survives complete corpus and full-cost screening.
candidates.positive_decision: Send the highest-information surviving operation to independent review, then freeze its cheapest decisive theorem or toy experiment.
candidates.negative_decision: Preserve the scoped duplicate or named-route boundary and rerank a distinct positive frontier; do not close ECDLP.
candidates.next_action: Execute TASK-20260721-001 within its frozen handoff.

ambiguities.question: What counts as novelty in the 410-slot corpus?
ambiguities.resolution: Require a distinct mathematical operation or information source with different exact output semantics and a fully represented cost, not a renamed backend or supplied-source transplant.
ambiguities.basis: The operation-level deduplication boundary in the recent DEDUP and REDTEAM reports.

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: A corpus-bound operation specification with explicit information source, matched rho/BSGS accounting, and a cheapest test whose outcomes change the next decision.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: Narrow to one theorem, literature, or instrument target; approve no experiment while the outcomes remain non-discriminating.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Prefer the interpretation with the larger represented state and weaker claim whenever source construction, target dependence, or amortization is not explicit.
peripheral_exclusions: Broad enumeration of unrelated algorithm names.
Modification or archival repair of pre-existing dirty ideas packages.
attention_contract.rerank_trigger: TASK-20260721-004 returns an independent terminal verdict on the verified producer snapshot.

resource_estimate.complexity_hypothesis: One bounded reasoning session can screen the existing corpus and fully cost at most three survivors.
resource_estimate.sharding_plan: Single producer session; no internal parallel writes.
resource_estimate.stop_rule: Stop after three fully costed survivors or a precise no-candidate frontier, whichever occurs first.

stages.purpose: Bind active, rejected, deferred, evidence, experiment, knowledge, and review records.
stages.stop_rule: Stop if the exact corpus or dirty-tree boundary cannot be recorded.

stages.purpose: Charge the complete attack path and matched baselines.
stages.stop_rule: Reject any survivor with an unstated dominant stage or source oracle.
Finish only when both exact deliverables satisfy the handoff gate.

candidates.title: Verifiable cryptanalytic methodology frontier
candidates.uncertainty: Whether a non-duplicate certificate, full-cost audit, benchmark, or falsification technique can materially improve a decision-critical ECDLP research stage.
candidates.positive_decision: Send the best technique to independent review, then freeze a bounded validation protocol.
candidates.negative_decision: Record one precise methodological gap and rerank; do not infer anything about ECDLP hardness.
candidates.next_action: Execute TASK-20260721-002 within its frozen handoff.

ambiguities.question: When is methodology cryptographically relevant rather than generic workflow?
ambiguities.resolution: Require an auditable artifact that changes a named ECDLP claim, validity, cost, or experiment decision and quantify its expected rigor or resource effect.
ambiguities.basis: The campaign objective and evidence-integrity rules in AGENTS.md and claims-and-verification.md.

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: A deduplicated technique with an exact auditable artifact, named decision impact, failure modes, and a bounded independent validation.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: Preserve one precise tooling or proof obligation and approve no implementation until its decision impact is explicit.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Classify value as methodological only unless a complete, separately testable path to attack-cost reduction is supplied.
peripheral_exclusions: Reimplementation of existing certificate or manifest checks without added decision power.
Any testing against live cryptographic keys or deployed systems.
attention_contract.rerank_trigger: TASK-20260721-005 returns an independent terminal verdict on the verified producer snapshot.

resource_estimate.dominant_cost: Cross-checking existing harness capabilities against decision-critical gaps.
resource_estimate.complexity_hypothesis: One bounded reasoning session can screen the harness and fully specify at most two methodological survivors.
resource_estimate.sharding_plan: Single producer session; no internal parallel writes.
resource_estimate.stop_rule: Stop after two fully specified survivors or one precise frontier-only gap.

stages.purpose: Bind current contracts, certificates, tools, experiments, and known techniques.
stages.stop_rule: Stop if the exact capability boundary cannot be recorded.

stages.purpose: Specify the cheapest auditable validation and quantify impact.
stages.stop_rule: Reject techniques without a bounded falsification artifact.
Finish only when both exact deliverables satisfy the handoff gate.

claims.scope: BATCH-001 corpus-bound theory screen only; no execution or cryptographic-scale inference.
claims.target_result: A reviewer-passed mechanism suitable for a separately frozen theorem or toy experiment.
claims.observed_result: No BATCH-001 producer or review result exists yet.
blockers: TASK-20260721-001 and TASK-20260721-004 are not complete.
